programme.title: Lumière du monde

programme.desc: The son of a notorious gunslinger attempts to bury his reputation and avoid his father's legacy in a small frontier town.

programme.title: Colt .45
programme.desc: A salesman (Randolph Scott) pursues a bank robber (Ruth Roman) who stole two of his repeating pistols.

programme.title: Bonanza
